responsibility: Implements the GCN offload-image builder invoked by GCC’s offloading pipeline. It runs the device compilation and link steps, post-processes generated GCN assembly, extracts and preserves relevant debug information, manages temporary files and environment cleanup, interprets AMDGPU ELF/HSA code-object flags such as architecture, XNACK, and SRAM-ECC, and finally converts the produced HSACO object into host C data that can be linked into the final executable as an embedded offload image.
